name: Resetify – Advanced Reset & Database Cleaner
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
Resetify provides a powerful, fast, and secure way to reset your WordPress site databases back to their default state without modifying files, or to selectively target specific data using Custom Resets.

It is the absolute best companion for theme and plugin developers, and agencies who frequently need to wipe content while keeping essential configurations intact.

🟢 Free Features Include:

  • Standard Reset: Wipe the site back to its default state while keeping your current admin logged in and preserving your basic settings.
  • Basic Custom Reset: Selectively delete Posts, Pages, Media, Comments, and Users while keeping everything else untouched.
  • Snapshots: Create lightning-fast backups of your database before making major changes, and instantly restore them with one click.
  • Database Cleanup Tools: Safely delete Transients, clean orphaned uploads, wipe revisions, auto-drafts, and empty trash.
  • Plugin / Theme Collections: Install your favorite bundles of plugins and themes with a single click.

⭐ PRO Features (Unlock Full Power):

  • Advanced Custom Resets: Reset Menus, Widgets, Theme Customizer modifications, core WordPress Options, Tags, and Categories directly.
  • Emergency Access Tool: Get locked out? White Screen of Death? Core files compromised? The single-file Emergency Access Tool creates a backdoor to reliably restore your site, even if WP-Admin is completely accessible.
  • Auto-Snapshots: Automatically create safety snapshots right before major updates or reset operations are performed.
  • Nuclear Reset: Drop ALL database tables, delete ALL files in uploads/themes/plugins, and regenerate your wp-config.php security salts. A literal “nuke from orbit” option.
  • Deep Database Cleansing: Detect and drop orphaned tables left behind by poorly coded plugins, and automatically run OPTIMIZE TABLE queries on your database.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the resetify folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Access the powerful tools in the newly created ‘Resetify’ menu item.
sections.faq:
Does this delete my files?

No. The standard reset strictly modifies the database. Your themes, plugins, and core WordPress files are never altered unless you choose to delete media uploads manually, or you execute the Nuclear Reset.

Are Snapshots safe?

Yes. Snapshots are securely stored in the wp-content/uploads/resetify-snapshots directory and protected from direct access via .htaccess.
sections.changelog:
2.1.0

  • Fixed update conflict between Free and PRO versions.
  • Updated descriptions and naming for better clarity.

2.0.0

  • Major Update: Split features into Free and PRO tiers.
  • Added Auto-Snapshots before WordPress core updates.
  • Introduced deep Database Detection for orphaned plugin tables.
  • Launch of the standalone Emergency Access Tool.
  • Renamed “Emergency Recovery Script” to “Emergency Access Tool”.
  • Improved layout and User Interface for the entire tool suite.

1.0.0

  • Initial release of Resetify.
